proof_sketch: With uniform values (all 1.0), every shared_mem[tid] entry equals the same local_sum (64). The parallel reduction race reads from higher indices and writes to lower indices, but with identical values, even 'wrong' reads produce correct results. Non-uniform values make the reduction order-dependent, so the race condition corrupts block sums. With variance ~1e6 in input and atol/rtol=1e-2, a 2%+ norm error in outputs near 1.0 triggers failure.
